description.en: ISS altitude. Closest view of the ground and easy to reach, but thin air drags you down: you need propellant to stay up.
description.zh-TW: 國際太空站的高度。離地面最近、最容易抵達，但稀薄大氣會把衛星往下拖，要帶推進劑才能維持軌道。

source.title: U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 (NASA NTRS); Adell (NASA-JPL) total dose table; Knap et al. 2020 Table 6
source.note: derived: drag dv 57 m/s/yr at moderate solar activity (a = 0.5 rho v^2 Cd A/m, rho = 2.8e-12 kg/m3 from USSA 1976, Cd = 2.2, A/m = 0.01). estimate: A/m and solar activity;~1-2 yr natural decay without reboost; dose 0.2 krad/yr (below the 1 krad/yr generic LEO value because 400 km sits under most of the inner belt); DoD 10-40% LEO (sourced); 4 passes/day of ~6 min for a 51.6 deg orbit (estimate)

name.zh-TW: 太陽同步軌道（700 公里）

description.en: The Landsat / OCO orbit. Passes over every place at the same local time, so lighting is consistent. Almost no drag.
description.zh-TW: Landsat 與 OCO 用的軌道。每天在同一個當地時間經過同一地點，光照條件一致，幾乎沒有大氣阻力。

source.title: OCO launch press kit (NASA/JPL 2009); Adell (NASA-JPL) total dose table
source.note: sourced: 705 km, 98.2 deg, 99 min period, passes 5-12 min (game 8); dose 'Earth (LEO-1 year) 1 krad' behind 100 mil Al. estimate: dv ~2 m/s/yr (drag ~0.6 + inclination upkeep), beta 25 deg typical for a 10:30 node, 11 of 14.6 daily passes seen by a high-latitude station (same assumption as the other 700 km SSOs), decades of natural lifetime

name.zh-TW: 地球同步軌道（35,786 公里）

description.en: Hovers over one spot and sees a whole hemisphere all day, but from 90x farther away, through harsh radiation, and needs a big rocket.
description.zh-TW: 停在同一點上空，整天看著半個地球；但距離遠 90 倍、輻射很強，還需要大火箭。

source.title: Kim et al., Station-Keeping for COMS Satellite, J. Astron. Space Sci. 23(3) 2006; Adell (NASA-JPL); Knap et al. 2020 Table 6
source.note: sourced: N-S 52.71 + E-W 3.50 m/s/yr (game 55); 'Earth (GEO-1 year) 30 krad'; GEO 90 cycles/yr, DoD 60-80% (game 75%). estimate: 10x lower downlink rate from 36,000 km after bigger ground antennas, 95% contact time, ~1 yr of usable drift without station keeping

description.en: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter territory. Lumpy lunar gravity pulls the orbit down fast, and every byte has to cross 384,000 km to the Deep Space Network.
description.zh-TW: 月球勘測軌道衛星（LRO）的高度。月球重力不均勻，軌道很快就會往下掉；每筆資料都要飛 38 萬公里回到深空網路。

source.title: Lauinger, Cotten & Zee, Optimization of Orbit-Maintenance Strategies for Small Satellites in Cislunar Space (SmallSat 2026); NASA MOCS D-22674
source.note: sourced: 50 km polar needs 10.5 m/s per lunation, consistent with LRO. estimate: ~50 m/s/yr at 100 km, months of natural lifetime, 2 krad/yr (no trapped belts), one 4 h DSN track per day, 20x lower rate than near-Earth

name.zh-TW: 晨昏太陽同步軌道（700 公里）

description.en: Rides the line between day and night, so the panels see the Sun most of the year. Around one solstice there is an eclipse season with up to about 19 minutes of shadow per orbit, still much shorter than other orbits. It passes over at 6 am and 6 pm, when fires are small.
description.zh-TW: 沿著日夜交界飛，一年中大部分時間太陽能板都照得到太陽。但在其中一個至日前後有一段「地影季」，每圈最多約 19 分鐘在影子裡，還是比其他軌道短很多。每天早上 6 點和傍晚 6 點經過，那時候火勢小。

source.title: eoPortal: RADARSAT Constellation Mission (dawn-dusk SSO); Giglio et al., MODIS active fire diurnal cycle (Remote Sens. Environ. 2006)
source.note: sourced: dawn-dusk SSO keeps |beta| near or above the ~64 deg no-eclipse angle at 700 km for most of the year, so radar missions use it for continuous power; fire activity peaks in the early afternoon and is lowest around dawn. derived: worst-case beta = 90 - 23.44 (solstice) - 8.19 (98.19 deg SSO inclination at 700 km) = 58.4 deg, below the 64.3 deg no-eclipse angle, so the battery must carry an 18.8 min shadow per 98.8 min orbit during the eclipse season (cylindrical shadow, same formula as the other orbits); the game sizes the battery for this worst case. estimate: x0.6 fire detection at 06:00/18:00 local time, 11 of 14.6 daily passes seen by a high-latitude polar station (SvalSat sees nearly every revolution)

name.zh-TW: 午後太陽同步軌道（700 公里，13:30）

description.en: The Aqua / Suomi NPP orbit: crosses the equator at 1:30 pm local time, when fires burn hottest. Every orbit spends about 35 minutes in Earth's shadow.
description.zh-TW: Aqua 和 Suomi NPP 用的軌道：當地時間下午 1 點半經過赤道，正是火勢最旺的時候。每一圈都有大約 35 分鐘在地球的影子裡。

source.title: NASA Earthdata: VIIRS I-Band 375 m Active Fire Data (Suomi NPP, 13:30 overpass); arXiv 2007.03675 App. B
source.note: sourced: Suomi NPP / NOAA-20 cross at about 13:30 local time and their active-fire product is used by fire services. derived: beta 15 deg gives a 34.7 min eclipse per 98.8 min orbit at 700 km (cylindrical shadow). estimate: x1.0 fire detection at the afternoon peak, 11 of 14.6 daily passes seen by a high-latitude polar station
